questions.stem: A quadrilateral has angles $x$, $2x$, $3x$, and $4x$. What is the value of $x$?
questions.explanation: The angles sum to $360°$, so $x + 2x + 3x + 4x = 360°$. This gives $10x = 360°$, hence $x = 36°$.

questions.stem: In a parallelogram, one angle is $115°$. What are the other three angles?
questions.explanation: In a parallelogram, opposite angles are equal and consecutive angles are supplementary ($180°$). So the angles are $115°$, $65°$, $115°$, $65°$.

questions.stem: A trapezium has two parallel sides. The two angles on the same side of a non-parallel side are $72°$ and $x$. What is $x$?
questions.explanation: Co-interior angles between parallel lines are supplementary. Therefore $72° + x = 180°$, giving $x = 108°$.
